rules: Install the real package components; never create lookalikes.
Preserve host handlers, routes, validation and infrastructure.
Brand through HighwayTheme. Component geometry, material and motion belong to the package.
Use the application type scale from docs/PACKAGES.md across adopted host content: body 14/20, dense tables 13/20, and the named heading/metadata roles. Brand fonts without inventing a second scale.
Analytics typography: tabular figures, weights 400/500/600, muted 14px secondary labels, dense tables 13/20 with expandable ~40px desktop rows, primary KPI 30px and secondary KPI 24px.
An alternative is supported but is not interchangeable with the recommended API.
If a required export is missing, report the gap or compose existing exports; do not modify Highway without authorization.

Select a family and a documented variant before implementation. Props describe implemented modes only; compatibility exports retain their existing contracts. Never infer interchangeability from appearance.

terminology.family: Related components and supported behavior modes grouped by purpose.
terminology.component: The component or behavior mode selected within a family, such as Button, SplitButton, or a multiple-selection Combobox.
terminology.appearance: Visual styling of a selected component, such as default, secondary, ghost, or destructive.
terminology.state: Interaction or lifecycle condition, such as disabled, loading, or error.
terminology.compatibility: The family variants field and select_variant tool retain their existing names for compatibility; they select family members or behavior modes, not visual appearance.
terminology.page: A discoverable component with a distinct purpose. Same-purpose API modes, appearance options, sizes and states stay on its page; families organize related pages.
